summary: Targeted retest completed for login-limit fix and responsive bead-collision fix on preview URL. Backend lockout behaviors passed all requested scenarios; hero responsiveness and WebGL motion checks passed across 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 at scroll 0/20/40/70 with no horizontal overflow and no observed text overlap.
action_items: Optional cleanup: remove legacy startup index creation on login_attempts.identifier since lockout now keys by _id hash.
Optional: investigate recurring frontend console warning about non-static scroll container from animation stack (not blocking behavior).
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout implementation now correctly normalizes account identity via sha256(email.lower().strip()) and no longer depends on proxy IP/forwarded headers.
Atomic failure aggregation with expiry-aware reset and Retry-After responses behaves correctly under sequential and concurrent attempts.
Auth cookie flags (HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None), CORS credentials with explicit origin, bcrypt $2b$ hash format, and protected admin auth flow are all validated working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused regression only. Added pytest file for lockout/casing/header/concurrency/expiry-reset/counter-clear/cookie/CORS/bcrypt checks. UI retest used browser automation artifacts under /app/test_reports/artifacts/iteration2_ui* with hero screenshots at required widths and scroll states plus WebGL canvas nonblank/change checks.
rca of the issue: Previously lockout keying split counters by proxy-dependent identifiers. Current implementation fixes root cause by stable normalized account hash key and atomic update logic; retest confirms first five 401 then 429, concurrent burst handling, expiry reset without TTL wait, and successful login clearing counter.
